title: MCP tools/call params
description: The `params` of an MCP `tools/call` request from the worker to the tool gateway (stateless Streamable HTTP, JSON responses, `/mcp`). Conventions around it: the run token (run-token.schema.json) goes in `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every request, `tools/list` included; `tools/list` shows only the token's tools, with annotations per connector-allowlist.schema.json (the worker reads readOnlyHint as read_only and idempotentHint as idempotent). A tool that fails returns a result with `isError: true` and a text the model may read (never a credential); a refused token or unknown tool is a JSON-RPC error. Rules not expressible here: `name` is in the token's tools; for a tool in the token's require_approval, the run's approval must match `agentplatform/step`, `name` and the canonical JSON of `arguments`.

arguments.description: Tool arguments as the model gave them, checked by the gateway against the tool's input schema.

_meta.description: MCP request metadata. Platform keys use the `agentplatform/` prefix; other MCP keys (progressToken) are allowed.

agentplatform/step.description: Step number of this call in the run (the approval check compares it).

agentplatform/idempotency_key.description: The worker's key for this call: SHA-256 hex of run id, step, tool and canonical arguments. Logged by the gateway.
